items.name: component-ui
items.title: NocoBase File Component UI
items.description: Application-owned upload, list, thumbnail, and preview components for business file endpoints.
items.docs: Install component-ui when an application needs editable file UI. Import its index.ts, create or pass a FilesClient for the consuming business endpoint, and keep route composition in the application. The item adds no route or server implementation. Review plugin upgrades with a three-way merge because installed files are application-owned.
